support.faqA6: Ee. Ị nwere ike iji OBS browser sources, presentation browser link, ma ọ bụ extended display dabere na kọmputa ofufe na projector gị.

supportExtended.faq1Question: Kedu ka m ga-esi jikọọ laptop ọhụrụ ma ọ bụ ihuenyo ngosi?
supportExtended.faq1Answer: Wụnye ngwa desktop MakeChurchEazy, banye, wee mepee Devices na dashboard iji jikọọ kọmputa ahụ. Ọ bụrụ na ị naghị eji OBS, detuo njikọ ngosi site na presentation mode ma mepee ya na ihuenyo ịchọrọ igosi.
supportExtended.faq2Question: Kedu ka esi agbakọ kredit AI?
supportExtended.faq2Answer: A na-eji kredit AI maka atụmatụ dịka Speech to Scripture na ntụgharị asụsụ. Ojiji dabere na atụmatụ na oke ederede ma ọ bụ olu a rụrụ. Ị nwere ike ilele balance gị na ibe Credits.
supportExtended.faq3Question: Enwere m ike iji ngwa ahụ na-enweghị ịntanetị?
supportExtended.faq3Answer: Ọtụtụ ọrụ ngosi nwere ike ịga n’ihu n’ime kọmputa mgbe egwu, ụdị Bible, media, na themes dị njikere. Ịntanetị dị mkpa maka ịbanye, syncing, nbudata, mmelite, ngwa AI, na ịkwụ ụgwọ.
supportExtended.faq4Question: Kedu ka m ga-esi gbanwee plan m?
supportExtended.faq4Answer: Gaa na Subscription > Plans iji tụnyere Free, Basic, na Growth. Upgrade ga-emeghe limits na credits nke plan ahụ mgbe akwadoro payment.
